Microsoft's research and development expense rose about 22.7% from fiscal Q1 2026 to fiscal Q4 2026.

- **Fiscal Q1 2026 (quarter ended Sept 30, 2025):** $8,146 million. This is the prior-year comparison figure in the fiscal Q1 2027 10-Q.
- **Fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026):** $9,997 million. This comes from Microsoft's Q4 earnings press release.
- **Calculation:** 9,997 ÷ 8,146 − 1 ≈ 22.7%.

The figures are consistent with the full-year total. Nine months of fiscal 2026 came to $25,565 million, and adding Q4's $9,997 million gives $35,562 million, which matches the reported full-year figure.
